title: Oxford University Is Older Than the Aztec Empire

segments.text: Oxford University was teaching students before the Aztec Empire even existed.
Teaching at Oxford began around the year 1096.
The Aztec capital wasn't founded until 1325.
That's more than two centuries later.
So while Oxford held lectures, the Aztec Empire hadn't begun.
A university older than an entire empire.
Follow for history they never taught you.

description: Oxford was teaching students 200+ years before the Aztec Empire was even founded. Follow for daily history!
